limitations: The independent probe only read public Sui. Installed UI cache clearing, cold start, native decryption, and Coordinator/cloud observations were performed separately and are attributed above.

Thirty-three ciphertext records and complete linked business histories were compared; the installed UI separately verified the listed original plaintext bodies and execution results. No claim that all 33 bodies were opened is made.

The unchanged Run/delivery sets, cloud signed-command counter and workspace hashes establish no new recorded execution or file change during this cache window. They do not constitute a packet-level count of every HTTP request.
Only current read Clock timestamps and local read times are excluded from business comparison. Persisted sampled/created/updated times and object versions remain compared.

The original transaction journal, 42 request rows/digests, delivery flags and draft attempted markers were retained. Clearing the connection and HTTP cache did not erase native keys or technical safety journals.

The one-off direct write acceptance remains incomplete. Earlier failed Runs and their partial file outcome remain visible; ONE-OFF-UI-VERIFIED.md is absent. No new write or approval was performed during cache reconstruction.

This scoped cache result does not complete the overall v0.2.0 goal. Android evidence is an installed debug APK in an emulator on localnet, with a real Ubuntu cloud Host; it is not physical-phone or five-platform production-release acceptance.
The repository stores only ciphertext/plaintext hashes and public metadata; no private key, recovery code, raw command signature or serialized signed payload is included.
